message.content: Li Hua provided feedback on Chae Song-hwa's medical knowledge lecture, expressing that it was "really insightful" and that she had learned a lot about the latest advancements in neurosurgery. She appreciated Chae Song-hwa's presentation style, which she found made complex topics easy to understand. Li Hua thanked Chae Song-hwa for the lecture and expressed her gratitude for his efforts. Additionally, she mentioned that she will likely have another lecture in a few months and will inform her about the date once it is set.
